old_caption: The video depicts a close-up view of a white plate placed on a yellow background. On the plate, there is a wooden popsicle stick with a small amount of yellowish-orange substance attached to it. The substance appears to be melting or dripping onto the plate, creating a pool of the same color around the stick. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the plate and the melting substance. The lighting is consistent, highlighting the vibrant colors of the substance and the plate against the yellow backdrop. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the video captures the gradual spread and pooling of the substance as it melts.

caption: The video depicts a white oval plate on a smooth orange-yellow background, holding a shallow pool of pale yellow liquid on the left and reddish-orange liquid on the right. A thin wooden stick lies diagonally across the pool, with a rounded yellowish gel-like dollop sitting on its middle. Throughout the visible excerpt, the dollop steadily loses height and flattens into the surrounding liquid. Its edges blur and merge with the pool, exposing more of the stick’s shaft and right-hand tip. The two-tone liquid remains present with only subtle shifts in the orange-red tint, while the plate, stick position, and background stay essentially fixed. The camera appears static, keeping the dissolving dollop centered as the gradual change continues.
